props.name: score
props.description: The score, when controlled. Should already include the reader’s own vote.

props.name: onVoteChange
props.description: Save the vote. The buttons update at once; a rejected promise puts them back.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the reason when saving fails and the vote is rolled back.

props.name: subject
props.description: What is being voted on, for the accessible names — "answer" gives "Upvote answer".

props.name: orientation
props.description: vertical is the Stack Overflow column; horizontal the inline row under a comment.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks voting — your own post, a locked thread.
